name: Budget direction
description: Whether a budget line is money coming in, money going out, or a financing move. This is required on every line, because a number alone doesn't tell you which way the money flows.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Revenue
hasDefinedTerm.description: Money received: taxes, grants, fees, fines.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Expenditure
hasDefinedTerm.description: Money spent to deliver government services.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Financing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Changes in assets and debts: borrowing, paying back loans, moving money to reserves.
